headline: Block (SQ) Stock Gets Fair Value Bump As Analysts Lift Targets On AI Progress
summary: Block is back in focus after a series of analysts lifted price targets toward about US$100, pointing to updated models that now sit closer to some fair value estimates around US$93.23. Recent commentary links these higher targets to Block’s AI push, the performance of Square and Cash App, and debate over how much of this is already reflected in the share price.
